title: Sauron recruits his future Ringwraiths in Rings of Power S3 trailer
gist: Prime Video released the full trailer for The Rings of Power season 3, which premieres November 11, 2026 with eight episodes through November 25, set after the fall of Eregion with Sauron's armies dominating Middle-earth.

themes.theme: Rings of Power S3 release and cast

insights.claim: The first four episodes of Rings of Power season 3 premiere on Prime Video on November 11, 2026, episodes five and six on November 18, and the final two on November 25.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Weekly release schedule defines the Prime Video engagement window.
insights.locator: The first four episodes of The Rings of Power S3

insights.claim: Prime Video made a major investment in the series by acquiring rights from the Tolkien estate and committing to multiple seasons upfront.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Multi-season commitment makes the series a long-term streaming content bet.
insights.locator: Prime Video made a major investment

insights.claim: Season 3 adds Jamie Campbell Bower as Celeborn, Zubin Varla as Khamul, Eddie Marsan as Thrain, Andrew Richardson as Anarion and Adam Young as an Orc named Marnukh, with Simon Pegg voicing the Balrog.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Name-recognition casting supports marketing for the season.
insights.locator: We’re also getting some new characters

insights.claim: Season 3 is set seven years after season 2, with Sauron's armies conquering most of Middle-earth and only Khazad-dum, Lindon and Rivendell holding out.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Story context for the season, no direct market impact.
insights.locator: In season three, Middle-earth is at war.
